paite: Israel kumpipa Jehoahaz tapa Jehoash kum nih alal kum in Judah kumpipa Joash tapa Amaziah alal pan hi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Amaziah / (2 Kro 25.1-24)
english: In the second year of Joash, son of Joahaz, king of Israel, Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah began to reign.

paite: Alal pat tung in kum sawmnih-le-nga a upa ahi a, Jerusalem ah kum sawmnih-le-kua alal a; anu min Jehoadan, Jerusalem mi ahi.
english: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jehoaddin of Jerusalem.

paite: TOUPA mitmuh in thil dik ahih a, himahleh apu David zaw apha kei; apa Joash thilhih bang ahih sam hi.
english: He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, yet not like David his father. He did according to all that Joash his father had done.

paite: Mun sangte lakmang ahi tuan kei a, mun sangte ah mite akithoih lai ua gimlim ahal lai uhi.
english: However the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places.

paite: Akhut a lalgam ahong kiptak in hichi ahong hi a, apa, kumpipa thatmi ama sikhate athat hi.
english: As soon as the kingdom was established in his hand, he killed his servants who had slain the king his father,

paite: Himahleh huai tualthat mite tate athat kei hi. Mosi Dan Bu a, "Tate ziak in pate hihlup ding ahi kei a, pate ziak in leng tate hihlup ding ahi sam kei, michih amau khelhna ziak in asi ding uh," chi a TOUPA thupiak gelh ahih bang in.
english: but the children of the murderers he didn’t put to death, according to that which is written in the book of the law of Moses, as Yahweh commanded, saying, “The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, nor the children be put to death for the fathers; but every man shall die for his own sin.”

paite: Edomte chi phaizang ah singkhat athat a, Selah khua asual a, ala a, amin ding in Joktheel asa a, tuni tan in hiai ahi lai hi.
english: He killed ten thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt, and took Sela by war, and called its name Joktheel, to this day.

paite: Huchi in Amaziah in Israel kumpipa Jehu tapa Jehoahaz tapa Jehoash kiang ah, hong kuan in, kimaituah ni, chi in mi asawl hi.
english: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Jehoash, the son of Jehoahaz son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, “Come, let’s look one another in the face.”

paite: Israel kumpipa Jehoash in Judah kumpipa Amaziah kiang ah, "Lebanon tang a ling in Lebanon tang a sidar sing kiang ah, na tanu ka tapa zi ding in neisak dih ve, chi in athukhak a; Lebanon tang a gamsa ahong pai a, huai ling ahong tuanpuk hi.
english: Jehoash the king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, “The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon, saying, ‘Give your daughter to my son as wife.’ Then a wild animal that was in Lebanon passed by, and trampled down the thistle.

paite: Nang Edomte na zou ngei a, na lungtang ahong kisathei hi; na kisaktheihna ompih maimai in; nang leh Judah nangawn tan a siatna, nang a dia hoih lou ding thil bang ding a khoihkhe ding na hia?" chi in adawng hi.
english: You have indeed struck Edom, and your heart has lifted you up. Enjoy the glory of it, and stay at home; for why should you meddle to your harm, that you fall, even you, and Judah with you?”

paite: Himahleh Amaziah in ana ngaikhe nuam kei a; huchi in Israel kumpipa Jehoash va hohtou in ava douta hi. Judah kumpipa Amaziah toh Judah gam Beth-shemesh ah ava kimaituahta uhi.
english: But Amaziah would not listen. So Jehoash king of Israel went up; and he and Amaziah king of Judah looked one another in the face at Beth Shemesh, which belongs to Judah.

paite: Judah bel Israelte ma ah azahlakta a; michih amau inn chiat ah ataikekta uh.
english: Judah was defeated by Israel; and each man fled to his tent.

paite: Israel kumpipa Jehoash in Judah kumpipa Ahaziah tapa Joash tapa Amaziah Beth-shemesh ah aman a, Jerusalem ah apaipih a, Jerusalem kulh, Ephraim kongpi a pan kulh ning kongpi pha in tong zali ahihchim hi.
english: Jehoash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Jehoash the son of Ahaziah, at Beth Shemesh and came to Jerusalem, then broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate, four hundred cubits.

paite: TOUPA' inn leh kumpipa' inn a gou koihkhawmna a dangka-eng leh dangka leh tui-um belsuan om tengteng ala a, thuchiam tangtunna dia mat a om mite toh, huchi in Samaria kholam ah apai nawnta hi.
english: He took all the gold and silver and all the vessels that were found in Yahweh’s house and in the treasures of the king’s house, the hostages also, and returned to Samaria.

paite: Huchi in Jehoash thilhih tanchin dangte, athilhihtheihdante, Judah kumpipa Amaziah adou thute Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoash which he did, and his might, and how he fought with Amaziah king of Judah, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

paite: Huchi in Jehoash api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmu a, Samaria ah Israel kumpipate lak ah avui ua; asik in atapa Jeroboam alalta hi.
english: Jehoash slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel; and Jeroboam his son reigned in his place.

paite: Judah kumpipa Joash tapa Amaziah Israel kumpipa Jehoahaz tapa Jehoash sih nung in kum sawm-le- nga adam lai hi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Amaziah Sihna / (2 Kro 25.25-28)
english: Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah lived after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz, king of Israel, fifteen years.

paite: Huchi in Amaziah tanchin dangte Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Amaziah, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

paite: Jerusalem ah amah aguksawm ua; huchi in Lakish ah mi adelhsak ua, huai ah athatta uhi.
english: They made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem, and he fled to Lachish; but they sent after him to Lachish and killed him there.

paite: Aluang sakol in apaipih ua, api-le-pute lak ah David khopi Jerusalem ah avui uhi.
english: They brought him on horses, and he was buried at Jerusalem with his fathers in David’s city.

paite: Judah mi tengteng in kum sawm leh kum guk a upa, Azariah api ua, apa Amaziah sik in kumpipa in abawl uhi.
english: All the people of Judah took Azariah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in the place of his father Amaziah.

paite: Ama'n Elath khua abawlhoih nawn in Judah gam ah apangsak nawn a; huai nung in kumpipa api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmuta hi.
english: He built Elath and restored it to Judah. After that the king slept with his fathers.

paite: Judah kumpipa Joash tapa Amaziah kum sawm-le-nga alal kum in Israel kumpipa Jehoash tapa Jeroboam Samaria ah alal pan a, kum sawmli-le-khat alal hi.
heading: Israel Kumpipa Jeroboam Nihna
english: In the fifteenth year of Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah, Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel began to reign in Samaria for forty-one years.

paite: TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou ahih a; Israelte thil ahihkhialsak a, Nebat tapa Jeroboam khelhna tengteng apaisan kei hi.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight. He didn’t depart from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin.

paite: TOUPA, Israelte Pathian in asikha, Gath hepher mi Amittai tapa zawlnei Jonah zang a athugen bang in, Hamath lutna a pan Arabah Tuipi pha in Israel gam ah apangsak nawn hi.
english: He restored the border of Israel from the entrance of Hamath to the sea of the Arabah, according to Yahweh, the God of Israel’s word, which he spoke by his servant Jonah the son of Amittai, the prophet, who was from Gath Hepher.

paite: TOUPA'N Israelte haksatna a thupi mahmah chih lah athei ngal a; sal hi in noplen hitaleh athuakdan uh akibang a; Israelte panpih ding kuamah om sam kei hi.
english: For Yahweh saw the affliction of Israel, that it was very bitter for all, slave and free; and there was no helper for Israel.

paite: TOUPA'N Israel min van nuai ah achimitsak zenzen ding chih ahihleh agen kei him a; Jehoash tapa Jeroboam zang in ahondam zawta hi.
english: Yahweh didn’t say that he would blot out the name of Israel from under the sky; but he saved them by the hand of Jeroboam the son of Joash.

paite: Huchi in Jeroboam tanchin dangte, athilhih tengtengte, athilhihtheihdante, agaldou thute, tuma lam in Judah gam tan hi gige Damaskas leh Hamath khua Israelte a dia ana laksak nawn thute Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, and all that he did, and his might, how he fought, and how he recovered Damascus, and Hamath, which had belonged to Judah, for Israel, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

paite: Jeroboam api leh pu, Israel kumpipate kiang ah a-ihmu samta a; huchi in atapa Zakariah asik in alalta hi.
english: Jeroboam slept with his fathers, even with the kings of Israel; and Zechariah his son reigned in his place.
